attempts.architecture: Final SE(3)-invariant molecular pipeline centered on GeometryEncoder, RadialEdgeEncoder and AttentionPairBlock, with separate TopologyRegressor and SequenceRegressor baselines. After the geometry refactor, the 3D encoder checkpoint contains 2,251,944 parameters and 33 weight matrices, while the topology baseline remains a distinct 858,881-parameter model.
attempts.augmentations: Pretraining uses the 50,000 unlabelled conformations with masked heavy-atom recovery and coordinate denoising. The implementation now uses symmetric pair typing, additive pair-conditioned radial channels, a rewritten distance correction path, and artifact export directly after pretraining. The ablation grid runs full-stack, half-scale, no-geometry, mask-only, from-scratch and ten-percent variants.
attempts.description: The final implementation passes every deterministic criterion and the final pass/fail checks with reward 1.0 and rubric_score 1.0. Current results from the latest run: test gap MAE is 0.2784384627180478, denoising RMSD is 0.1709030831106102 A, and masked-atom accuracy is 0.9793336673346693. Validation checks show 3D MAE 0.270 eV versus 2D 0.737 eV and 1D 0.470 eV; topology and sequence-only splits score 0.711 and 0.479 eV respectively. The ablation remains informative: full-stack reaches 0.387 eV, half-scale 0.409 eV, no-geometry 0.830 eV, mask-only 0.390 eV, from-scratch 0.825 eV and ten-percent 0.763 eV.
